190        public CampaignFleetAPI createFleet(StarSystemAPI system, Random random) {
191        
192                float f = intel.getMarketPresenceFactor(system);
193                
194                // even if magnitude is not factored in, if it's 0 fleets won't spawn
195                // and its value affects the likelihood of tritach fleets spawning
196                //getEffectMagnitude(system);
197                
198                int difficulty = 4 + (int) Math.round(f * 4f);
199                
200                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
201                m.beginFleet();
202                
203                Vector2f loc = system.getLocation();
204                String factionId = Factions.TRITACHYON;
205                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
206                        factionId = Factions.MERCENARY;
207                }
208                
209                m.createQualityFleet(difficulty, factionId, loc);
210                
211                if (difficulty <= 5) {
212                        m.triggerSetFleetQuality(FleetQuality.SMOD_1);
213                } else if (difficulty <= 7) {
214                        m.triggerSetFleetQuality(FleetQuality.SMOD_2);
215                } else {
216                        m.triggerSetFleetQuality(FleetQuality.SMOD_3);
217                }
218                
219                m.triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
220                m.triggerSetFleetType(FleetTypes.COMMERCE_RAIDERS);
221                
222                m.triggerSetPirateFleet();
223                //m.triggerMakeHostile();
224                m.triggerMakeNonHostileToFaction(Factions.TRITACHYON);
225                m.triggerMakeHostileToAllTradeFleets();
226                m.triggerMakeEveryoneJoinBattleAgainst();
227                
228                m.triggerMakeNonHostileToFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
229                m.triggerMakeNoRepImpact();
230                m.triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
231                
232                m.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.COORDINATED_MANEUVERS, 1);
233                m.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.ELECTRONIC_WARFARE, 1);
234//              m.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.FLUX_REGULATION, 1);
235//              m.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.PHASE_CORPS, 1);
236//              m.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.CARRIER_GROUP, 1);
237                
238                m.triggerSetFleetFlag(COMMERCE_RAIDER_FLEET);
239                
240                int tugs = 0;
241                if (Factions.MERCENARY.equals(factionId)) {
242                        tugs = random.nextInt(3);
243                }
244                
245                m.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, tugs, true);
246                m.triggerSetFleetMaxShipSize(3);
247                
248                
249                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
250
251                return fleet;
252        }

306        public float getEventFrequency(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
307                if (stage.id == Stage.HA_EVENT) {
308                        
309                        if (isPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach() || getPrimaryTriTachyonSystem() == null) {
310                                return 0f;
311                        }
312                        
313                        if (isPlayerDefeatedMercAttack() || isPlayerBribedMercAttack()) {
314                                return 0f;
315                        }
316                        
317                        StarSystemAPI target = findExpeditionTarget(intel, stage);
318                        MarketAPI source = findExpeditionSource(intel, stage, target);
319                        if (target != null && source != null) {
320                                return 10f;
321                        }
322                }
323                return 0;
324        }

346        public static StarSystemAPI findExpeditionTarget(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage) {
347                List<CompetitorData> data = TriTachyonStandardActivityCause.computePlayerCompetitionData();
348                CountingMap<StarSystemAPI> counts = new CountingMap<StarSystemAPI>();
349                
350                for (CompetitorData curr : data) {
351                        for (MarketAPI market : curr.competitorProducers) {
352                                StarSystemAPI system = market.getStarSystem();
353                                if (system == null) continue;
354                                int weight = market.getCommodityData(curr.commodityId).getMaxSupply();
355                                counts.add(system, weight);
356                        }
357                }
358                
359                return counts.getLargest();
360        }
361        
362        public static MarketAPI findExpeditionSource(HostileActivityEventIntel intel, EventStageData stage, StarSystemAPI target) {
363                if (getNortia() != null) return getNortia();
364                
365                
366                CountingMap<MarketAPI> scores = new CountingMap<MarketAPI>();
367                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getFactionMarkets(Factions.TRITACHYON)) {
368                        int size = market.getSize();
369                        int weight = size;
370                        if (Misc.isMilitary(market)) weight += size * 10;
371                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.ORBITALWORKS)) weight += size;
372                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.HEAVYINDUSTRY)) weight += size;
373                        
374                        scores.add(market, weight);
375                }
376                
377                return scores.getLargest();
378        }

383                                !nortia.getFactionId().equals(Factions.INDEPENDENT)) {
384                        return null;
385                }
386                return nortia;
387        }

442        public static StarSystemAPI getPrimaryTriTachyonSystem() {
443                CountingMap<StarSystemAPI> counts = new CountingMap<StarSystemAPI>();
444                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
445                        if (!Factions.TRITACHYON.equals(market.getFactionId())) continue;
446                        StarSystemAPI system = market.getStarSystem();
447                        if (system == null) continue;
448                        int size = market.getSize();
449                        int weight = size;
450                        if (Misc.isMilitary(market)) weight += size;
451                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.ORBITALWORKS)) weight += size;
452                        if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.HEAVYINDUSTRY)) weight += size;
453                        
454                        counts.add(system, weight);
455                }
456                return counts.getLargest();
457        }

459        
460        public boolean startMercenaryAttack(MarketAPI source, StarSystemAPI target, 
461                                                EventStageData stage, HostileActivityEventIntel intel, Random random) {
462                if (isPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach()) return false;
463                if (source == null || target == null) return false;
464                
465                GenericRaidParams params = new GenericRaidParams(new Random(random.nextLong()), true);
466                params.makeFleetsHostile = false; // will be made hostile when they arrive, not before
467                params.source = source;
468                
469                params.prepDays = 21f + random.nextFloat() * 7f;
470                params.payloadDays = 27f + 7f * random.nextFloat();
471                
472                params.raidParams.where = target;
473                params.raidParams.type = FGRaidType.SEQUENTIAL;
474                
475                Set<String> disrupt = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
476                for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getMarketsInLocation(target, Factions.PLAYER)) {
477                        params.raidParams.allowedTargets.add(market);
478                        params.raidParams.allowNonHostileTargets = true;
479                        for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
480                                if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_UNRAIDABLE)) continue;
481                                disrupt.add(ind.getId());
482                                
483                        }
484                }
485                
486                params.raidParams.disrupt.addAll(disrupt);
487                params.raidParams.raidsPerColony = Math.min(disrupt.size(), 4);
488                if (disrupt.isEmpty()) {
489                        params.raidParams.raidsPerColony = 2;
490                }
491                
492                if (params.raidParams.allowedTargets.isEmpty()) {
493                        return false;
494                }
495                
496                params.factionId = Factions.INDEPENDENT;
497                params.style = FleetStyle.QUALITY;
498                params.repImpact = ComplicationRepImpact.NONE;
499                
500                
501                float fleetSizeMult = 1f;
502                
503                float f = intel.getMarketPresenceFactor(target);
504                
505                float totalDifficulty = fleetSizeMult * 50f * (0.5f + 0.5f * f);
506
507                totalDifficulty -= 10;
508                params.fleetSizes.add(10); // first size 10 pick becomes the Operational Command
509                
510                while (totalDifficulty > 0) {
511                        int min = 3;
512                        int max = 8;
513                        
514                        //int diff = Math.round(StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(random, min, max));
515                        int diff = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
516                        
517                        params.fleetSizes.add(diff);
518                        totalDifficulty -= diff;
519                }
520                
521                TTMercenaryAttack attack = new TTMercenaryAttack(params);
522                attack.setListener(this);
523                //attack.setPreFleetDeploymentDelay(30f + random.nextFloat() * 60f);
524                //attack.setPreFleetDeploymentDelay(1f);
525                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(attack, false);           
526                
527                return true;
528        }

535        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
536                if (isPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach()) return;
537                
538                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
539                
540                if (getProgress(null) <= 0 && TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.get() == null) return;
541                
542                int traderFP = 0;
543                int raiderFP = 0;
544                for (CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet : battle.getNonPlayerSideSnapshot()) {
545                        //if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().isHostileTo(otherFleet.getFaction())) continue;
546                        boolean trader = isTraderServingATTColony(otherFleet);
547                        boolean raider = isCommerceRaider(otherFleet);
548                        
549                        if (!trader && !raider) continue;
550                        
551                        int mult = 1;
552                        if (trader) mult = TTCRPoints.TRADE_FLEET_FP_MULT;
553                        
554                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(otherFleet)) {
555                                int fp = loss.getFleetPointCost() * mult;
556                                if (trader) {
557                                        traderFP += fp;
558                                } else if (raider) {
559                                        raiderFP += fp;
560                                }
561                        }
562                }
563        
564                if (traderFP > 0) {
565                        int points = computeTTCRProgressPoints(traderFP);
566                        if (points > 0) {
567                                TTCRTradeFleetsDestroyedFactor factor = new TTCRTradeFleetsDestroyedFactor(points);
568                                TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(factor, null);
569                        }
570                }
571                if (raiderFP > 0) {
572                        int points = computeTTCRProgressPoints(raiderFP);
573                        if (points > 0) {
574                                TTCRCommerceRaidersDestroyedFactor factor = new TTCRCommerceRaidersDestroyedFactor(points);
575                                TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(factor, null);
576                        }
577                }
578        }

580        public static boolean isCommerceRaider(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
581                return fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(TriTachyonHostileActivityFactor.COMMERCE_RAIDER_FLEET);
582        }
583        public static boolean isTraderServingATTColony(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
584                boolean trader = Misc.isTrader(fleet);
585                boolean smuggler = Misc.isSmuggler(fleet);
586                
587                if (!trader && !smuggler) return false;
588                
589                RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().getRoute(EconomyFleetRouteManager.SOURCE_ID, fleet);
590                if (route == null) return false;
591                
592                EconomyRouteData data = (EconomyRouteData) route.getCustom();
593                if (data == null) return false;
594                
595                if (data.from != null && Factions.TRITACHYON.equals(data.from.getFactionId())) {
596                        return true;
597                }
598                if (data.to != null && Factions.TRITACHYON.equals(data.to.getFactionId())) {
599                        return true;
600                }
601                        
602                return false;
603        }
604        
605        public static int computeTTCRProgressPoints(float fleetPointsDestroyed) {
606                if (fleetPointsDestroyed <= 0) return 0;
607                
608                int points = Math.round(fleetPointsDestroyed / (float) TTCRPoints.FP_PER_POINT);
609                if (points < 1) points = 1;
610                return points;
611        }
612        
613        public static int computeIndustryDisruptPoints(Industry ind) {
614                float base = ind.getSpec().getDisruptDanger().disruptionDays;
615                float per = TTCRPoints.BASE_POINTS_FOR_INDUSTRY_DISRUPT;
616                
617                float days = ind.getDisruptedDays();
618                
619                int points = (int) Math.round(days / base * per);
620                if (points > TTCRPoints.MAX_POINTS_FOR_INDUSTRY_DISRUPT) {
621                        points = TTCRPoints.MAX_POINTS_FOR_INDUSTRY_DISRUPT;
622                }
623                return points;
624        }

657        public void applyMassIndustryDisruptionToTTCR(MarketAPI market, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
658                if (isPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach()) return;
659                if (getProgress(null) <= 0 && TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.get() == null) return;
660                
661                int points = 0;
662                for (Industry industry : market.getIndustries()) {
663                        if (recentlyDisrupted.contains(industry)) continue;
664                        if (industry.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_UNRAIDABLE)) continue;
665                        
666                        int curr = computeIndustryDisruptPoints(industry);
667                        if (curr > 0) {
668                                points += curr;
669                                recentlyDisrupted.add(industry, industry.getDisruptedDays());
670                        }
671                }
672                
673                if (points > 0) {
674                        TTCRIndustryDisruptedFactor factor = new TTCRIndustryDisruptedFactor(
675                                        "Disrupted industries " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName(), points);
676                        TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(factor, dialog);
677                }
678        }
679        public void applyIndustryDisruptionToTTCR(Industry industry, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
680                if (isPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach()) return;
681                if (getProgress(null) <= 0 && TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.get() == null) return;
682                
683                if (!recentlyDisrupted.contains(industry)) {
684                        if (industry.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_UNRAIDABLE)) return;
685                        MarketAPI market = industry.getMarket();
686                        if (market == null) return;
687                        
688                        int points = computeIndustryDisruptPoints(industry);
689                        if (points > 0) {
690                                TTCRIndustryDisruptedFactor factor = new TTCRIndustryDisruptedFactor(
691                                                industry.getCurrentName() + " " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
692                                                " disrupted", points);
693                                TriTachyonCommerceRaiding.addFactorCreateIfNecessary(factor, dialog);
694                                recentlyDisrupted.add(industry, industry.getDisruptedDays());
695                        }
696                }
697        }
